title: Local event logger with structured JSON logging and export
description: Implement logging_service/event_logger.py to record timestamped system lifecycle events, camera faults, and alert transitions locally into rotating JSON/JSONL format with clear and export capabilities.
acceptanceCriteria: EventLogger records structured entries with timestamp, event_type, severity, and message
Events are stored locally in a log file (e.g., logs/events.jsonl)
API provides methods to fetch recent events, export to JSON/CSV, and clear logs with confirmation
Unit tests verify event addition, retrieval, filtering, and export

steps.details: Create logging_service/event_logger.py with EventEntry dataclass containing timestamp (ISO 8601), event_type, severity (info, warning, critical), and description.
Implement log_event(), get_recent_events(limit), export_events(format), and clear_events(). Ensure thread safety.

steps.description: Add log rotation and file storage
steps.details: Ensure event log file creates directories if missing, rotates when exceeding size limits, and avoids writing raw video or biometric images.
Create tests/test_event_logger.py to verify structured recording, persistence, in-memory buffering, and export.

technicalNotes: Do not store video frames or facial images in logs to adhere to privacy requirements FR-10.
File size should stay under 250 lines.
